title: SFO–YVR: Gauri Sen
notice: Source-reviewed against Canadian government publications on 2026-10-25. Passenger and document data are fictional; no independent human review is claimed.

review.notes: Checked the authored evidence path, exceptions and disposition against ca-visitor-visa. See docs/content-review-2026-10-25.md. This is an agent source review, not independent human or immigration-authority approval.

assumptions: Adult passenger on the direct commercial SFO–YVR flight; ordinary genuine documents, matching identity, and all non-document airline checks are stipulated satisfied. No decision here guarantees admission at the Canadian border.

Only the declared citizenship and residence status apply. No unmentioned second passport, US/Canadian permanent-resident status, diplomatic exception, or other travel-permission exception is available.
Passenger names and document numbers are synthetic. Electronic authorization results are simulated carrier checks, never live calls and never a requirement to carry an eTA printout.
clues: The Indian visitor presents only a passport. No second nationality or US/Canadian resident status is declared. Resolve whether any Canadian travel permission is available.

questions.label: Ask for Canadian travel permission
questions.response: I have no Canadian visa and no other qualifying Canadian permission, passport or resident status.

rationale: The inquiry confirms no qualifying permission remains obtainable. Under these stated visitor facts, the Indian passport alone is insufficient; the selected-nationality eTA route does not apply.
